room.organization: West-wall longitudinal bed, north-window morning surface, south-wall wardrobe, and a separate east reading pocket connected by an L-shaped circulation route.
room.main_path: From door_00 on the east-south wall, pass north-west around the reading pocket, reach the central bed side, then continue north to chair_01 and desk_01.
room.protected_open_space: The east-central landing, bed's accessible east side, desk chair pull-back strip, and wardrobe front remain free of unrelated furniture.

furniture.placement_rationale: bed_01 runs longitudinally along the west wall, keeping its east long side accessible from the central landing and avoiding the north window_00 band. Its yaw pi/2 turns the long depth along room X, so the bed does not divide the room and the door_00 approach can pass on the east side.

nightstand_01 sits at bed_01's north head-side corner rather than duplicating a pair, leaving the east side open for entry and making one reachable surface sufficient. Its local -Y front faces south toward the bed and its north clearance does not intrude on window_00.

desk_01 occupies the north wall below window_00, with a 0.39 m rear setback from the window clearance so morning light reaches the surface without overlap. Its local -Y front faces chair_01 and the central room, while the desk stays east of bed_01's accessible side.

chair_01 is the single desk seat for desk_01, facing north with its local -Y front toward the work surface. The south pull-back strip remains part of the east-central route from door_00, and the chair does not compete with bed_01's bedside access.

wardrobe_01 uses the south wall so its tall storage does not compete with window_00 or the east door_00 landing. Its yaw pi turns the local -Y front north into the room, leaving the shallow back on the south wall and giving a direct dressing approach from the central landing.

armchair_01 forms a quiet reading pocket in the east-south corner while its west-shifted footprint stays clear of door_00's east-side clearance. Its yaw -pi/2 points the local -Y front west toward the room, keeping the central landing visually open and separating reading from the bed axis.

side_table_01 sits immediately west of the west-shifted armchair_01 within arm's reach for reading material, but remains outside bed_01 and chair_01 pull-back zones. Its neutral yaw suits the square top and preserves a clean west-facing reading front.

revision.change: Moved side_table_01 0.02 m west so its OBB has a positive gap from armchair_01.
